# SENO Avian Genetic Test — Technical Documentation Center
> Official SENO Testing Center technical documentation for avian DNA sexing, PCR disease diagnostics, racing pigeon genetics, sample collection protocols, and laboratory quality systems
> Operated by Zhangjiakou SENO Testing Center Co., Ltd.
> Last Updated: August 2026

## Organization
- **Name:** Zhangjiakou SENO Testing Center Co., Ltd.
- **Brand:** SENO International Avian Genetic Test
- **Website:** [aviantestpro.com](https://aviantestpro.com)
- **Documentation:** [docs.aviantestpro.com](https://docs.aviantestpro.com)
- **Email:** lab@aviantestpro.com

## Description
Complete technical documentation for avian genetic testing services covering DNA gender determination (CHD-W/CHD-Z PCR), avian disease diagnostics (PBFD/BFDV qPCR, APV, avian influenza, 11-pathogen pigeon panel), racing pigeon genetics (DRD4/LDHA/CK/MB performance markers, 12-locus microsatellite fingerprinting), sample collection protocols (feather, blood, swab, FTA card), international shipping procedures, laboratory QC/SOPs, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 quality systems, and species-specific testing guides for psittacines, columbiformes, and passerines.

## Key Facts

### DNA Sexing (CHD-W/CHD-Z PCR)
- Principle: Females are ZW (heterogametic), males are ZZ (homogametic)
- Detection: PCR amplification of CHD-W (female-specific) and CHD-Z (both sexes)
- Primer sets: P2/P8 or 2550F/2718R — conserved across 250+ avian species
- Accuracy: ≥99% validated
- Turnaround: 1–2 working days
- Fragment analysis: Capillary electrophoresis preferred over gel

### Disease Testing
- PBFD qPCR: LOD 10 copies/rxn, 95.9% sensitivity, 98.0% specificity
- APV (avian polyomavirus): PCR detection from feather/blood/swab
- Pigeon Panel: 11 pathogens (PiCV, PiHV, PiADV, Chlamydia, Salmonella, Candida, E. coli, Pseudomonas, Staphylococcus, PPMV-1, PBFD)
- AIV: H5/H7/H9 RT-PCR multiplex

### Racing Pigeon Genetics
- Performance markers: DRD4 (behavior/homing), LDHA (endurance), CK (sprint), MB (stamina)
- Results: Gold/Silver/Bronze classification
- DNA fingerprinting: 12-locus STR, >99.99% discrimination power
- Monthly volume: 600+ performance gene tests, 500+ virus PCR tests

### Laboratory
- Location: Zhangjiakou, Hebei, China
- Facility: 3,000 m²
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, National High-Tech Enterprise
- International shipping to 20+ countries
- English reports for all international clients

### Quality Metrics
- DNA sexing accuracy: ≥99%
- PBFD analytical sensitivity: 95.9%
- PBFD analytical specificity: 98.0%
- Fingerprinting match probability: <1 in 2.5×10¹⁵ (12 loci)
- Retesting policy: Free retest on disputed results
